doc_locator: Arrêté n° 2023-189/PRE, article 1 (products one figure); Arrêté n° 2024-044/PR/MEFI, article 1 likewise
notes: The bodies' budget arrêtés print products as one figure with no financing split, and the finance laws print external grants and loans only as national totals by economic title (Dons; Extérieur crédit) with no ministry or project, so no externally financed digital line is printed in any held document. World Bank-financed digital projects run outside every held budget document.
